# GitHub Issue templates — all phases

Issues are **actionable units of work** linked to the official WBS and GitHub Projects board, not the PA submissions themselves.

Available forms:
- [Work package](work_package.yml): one assignable leaf of the PA1 WBS, with measurable deliverables, hours, dependency, owner/reviewer and due date.
- [Bug report](bug_report.yml): reproducible defects with expected/actual outcome and proof. Use once testing/code exists.
- [Change request](change_request.yml): any proposed change to scope, architecture, approved requirements or phase baselines, with options, impact and approval.

**Workflow:** team agrees on task → create Issue → link to GitHub Project → set Assignee, Due date, Phase, Priority and Status → work in PR → review/evidence → Done.

**Important:** no new tasks should be assigned solely from an unapproved estimate or guessed team decision. Do not create 35 speculative issues before the PA1 meeting. Older setup/planning issues were closed as **not planned** to clean the active board; closure is **not permanent deletion**.

If an Issue does not clearly describe what output will be reviewed, split or revise it before assigning.
